title: Meshes do not load (are invisible) after reopening the project
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.7.2 stable as well as 4.7.1 stable

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable (ed1daf0bf) - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:16:08 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (nvidia; 595.71.05) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-11400H @ 2.70GHz (12 threads) - 15.39 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

I Closed the project. Came back several hours later, and when i open it up. all the meshes in the current scene (the player) were invisible. Tried reopening the project, restart the PC, manually Hide / Show the meshes, but nothing

The Scene includes a collision shape ( capsule ) for the player, a skeleton3d, twoBoneIK3D (to chain the hands on the sword), and the sword itself (with a mesh + colison Shape)

the nodes are still there. collision shape still there, the logic works, no errors no crashes. just that the meshes are invisible

I've tried deleting the .godot folder, but that did not solved the problem

the only way i could solve it, was to reimport the hands and the sword meshes and switch the old ones for the new.

that was yesterday. Today i stoped working, left the engine running, but the screen went off (went to sleep) 
when i opened it up, again, the Meshes are invisible

so i'm assuming it has something to do with the sleep state of the laptop. even tho i've seen the same bug reported in 2023 on Godot 4.2 Windows

### Steps to reproduce

import some meshes on a CharacterBody3D like Hands
leave the screen on until it goes to sleep



### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)


[Insisible_mesh_test_project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31263415/Insisible_mesh_test_project.zip)
